headline: Culqi to Connect Businesses to Peru's Central Bank Payment System TAPP
summary: BCP's Culqi announced the development of Culqi Connect, a multi-rail infrastructure gateway to connect businesses to TAPP, the new payment system driven by Peru's Central Reserve Bank.
why: Modernizing national payment rails enhances transaction speed and digital inclusion, directly impacting fintech adoption and merchant processing volumes.

impacts.name: Culqi
impacts.why: Integration with the central bank's TAPP payment system broadens service offerings and merchant connectivity.
